**TPC Restore AI Windows** — a free, open-source product of [The Portland Company](https://theportlandcompany.com).

## What's new in 1.1.0

- **Restored sessions pick up on their own.** Each reopened Claude Code session now actually receives its "continue where you left off" message instead of leaving it sitting in the input box.
- **Watch the restore happen.** A progress bar in the app, plus a temporary menu-bar item that shows up during a restore and disappears when it's done.
- **Your Mac stays responsive.** Sessions are resumed a few at a time instead of all at once.
- **Fewer missed sessions.** A session is no longer dropped from the snapshot just because you moved into a subfolder, and the snapshot now reads what's really open in iTerm.
- **Cleaner app window.** All actions on one row, plain-English tooltips on every button, and the window scrolls and resizes properly.

**Download:** `RestoreAIWindows-1.1.0.dmg` below · Website: https://restoreaiwindows.theportlandcompany.com
